confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'it is almost certainly a failed drain pump' - sump/pump-to-tub hose blockage never checked and the impeller still turns

unjustifiedPart.evidence: 'you can order a compatible drain pump for your Bosch model and replace it yourself' - before the model was known and before the sump route was ruled out

rationale: The assistant asked sensible, safe checks (pump hum, unplug then turn impeller) and correctly told the customer that 'FD 9409' is not enough to order a pump, finally escalating to an engineer when the E-Nr could not be read. However it declared the pump 'almost certainly' failed without considering a sump/tub-to-pump hose blockage, told him to order a drain pump before any model was established, and asserted an unsupported claim that the E-Nr plate sits under the top lid rather than suggesting receipt, Bosch registration or the manufacturer as routes to the model number. No fabricated customer evidence, no unsafe instruction, and no looping, so the outcome is a safe but somewhat overconfident hand-off.
